name: phone_wallx
goal: Phone scanner scenario: the robot holds until the handheld phone scanner (dashboard /scan) reads the parcel's label; the harness routes the code (zone + arm) and prompts WALLX, which picks the parcel up and puts it into that zone; release, home.
setup: Parcel in the middle of the table; phone scanner page open (https://<Mac IP>:8443/scan); arms at rest. Scan the label with the phone after pressing the button (or up to 3 min before).
